info.title: FUSE Brand API (External)
info.description:
Server-to-server API exposing the FUSE brand-admin surface so a single brand/tenant can build its own admin frontend. Every request is authenticated with an API key bound to exactly one clinic; all data is auto-scoped to that clinic and cannot reach another brand's data. Isolation is enforced by application-layer clinic filtering on every query.

COVERAGE: 218 operations across 180 paths, and EVERY ONE is available to every brand. There is no per-clinic enablement step. What governs access: your API key and its scopes, the clinic the key belongs to (every read and write is filtered to it), your plan's entitlements for the two commercially-gated areas — Affiliates (`AFFILIATES_TIER_REQUIRED`) and CRM Connect (`CRM_TIER_REQUIRED`) — and rate limits.

AUTH: the external /api/v1 surface uses an API key (`x-api-key`, ApiKeyAuth). Key management (/api-keys) and /auth/signin live at the API root and use a brand-admin JWT (BearerAuth); /auth/signin itself is unauthenticated.

SCOPES: every key carries scopes; read-only is the default and mutating endpoints require the `write` scope (403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE otherwise). Keys default to a 1-year expiry.

RATE LIMITING: every endpoint may additionally return `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header; 429 is not repeated on each operation below.

get.summary: Lab lifecycle state and lab-kit tracking for one order.
get.description:
Lab lifecycle STATE for one of the key clinic's orders: the current stage, a stage-by-stage timeline with timestamps, and the lab-kit shipment carrier/tracking numbers for both legs (FUSE to patient, patient to lab).

This endpoint deliberately exposes NO lab result content — no analyte values, reference ranges, interpretations, result documents, requisition PDFs, or results-review booking links. `resultsAvailableAt` is a timestamp only: it tells you the lab has reported, not what it reported.

Requires the `v1_fulfillment` endpoint group to be enabled for your clinic (contact FUSE). Returns 404 for an unknown, malformed, or another clinic's order id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Order id (UUID). Must belong to the API key's clinic.

isLabGated.description: Whether this order uses the lab-gated split-payment flow.

orderStatus.description: The order's overall status. Lab-related values include `awaiting_lab_results`, `awaiting_renewal_lab`, `authorization_failed`, `authorized_awaiting_review`.

stage.description: Current lab lifecycle stage; `null` when the order has no lab leg yet.

timeline.description: All six stages in lifecycle order. `reached` is true for the current stage and every stage before it. `occurredAt` is null for unreached stages and for the two shipment stages, which carry carrier/tracking but no dedicated timestamp.

kitShipmentToPatient.description: Outbound leg — lab kit shipped to the patient.

kitShipmentToLab.description: Return leg — patient's sample shipped to the lab.

resultsAvailableAt.description: When the lab reported results. TIMESTAMP ONLY — the result content itself is never exposed on this API.

403.description: The `v1_fulfillment` endpoint group is not enabled for your clinic

404.description: Order not found. Returned for an unknown id, a malformed (non-UUID) id, and an id belonging to another clinic — the three are deliberately indistinguishable.

get.summary: Telehealth visit status and appointment time for one order.
get.description:
Whether the patient has booked their live (synchronous) visit, has not booked yet, or did not attend — plus the appointment time when one is scheduled. This is the read side of the `appointment.scheduled` / `appointment.cancelled` webhooks: those notify you that something changed and carry ids only, and this endpoint tells you what the state now is.

`visitStatus` is a FUSE-defined value, deliberately independent of any doctor network's internal naming, so it is stable across changes FUSE makes behind the scenes. Treat it as a closed set and handle an unrecognised value defensively.

Before chasing a patient to book, check `bookingRequired`. Asynchronous treatments never require a live appointment and rest permanently at `not_booked` — that is normal, not an outstanding task. `bookingRequired` is `null` when the order predates visit-type resolution (unknown, not "no appointment needed").

This endpoint exposes NO clinical content: no prescriber name, NPI or phone, no prescribed medications, no visit outcome, and no lab results. A referred visit is already visible via the order's own `status`.

Requires the `v1_fulfillment` endpoint group to be enabled for your clinic (contact FUSE). Returns 404 for an unknown, malformed, or another clinic's order id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Order id (UUID). Must belong to the API key's clinic.

visitStatus.description:
`not_booked` — no live appointment is confirmed. Either the patient has not booked yet, or the treatment is asynchronous in their state and never requires one (check `bookingRequired`).
`booked` — a live visit is confirmed; see `scheduledAt`.
`no_show` — the patient did not attend the confirmed appointment.
`concluded` — the visit is complete (consult finished and/or prescription written); no further patient action is needed.
`cancelled` — the visit was cancelled; FUSE cancels the order alongside it, so the order's own status reflects it too.

bookingRequired.description: Whether this order's visit type requires a live appointment at all. `false` for asynchronous treatments. `null` when the order predates visit-type resolution — unknown, NOT "no appointment needed".

scheduledAt.description: The appointment time, when the doctor network supplied one. Retained after a `no_show` (it is the appointment that was missed). `null` whenever no appointment has been scheduled.

lastSyncedAt.description: When the doctor network last sent FUSE any update about this visit. Use it to tell "no appointment has been booked" apart from "we have not heard anything recently" — a stale value on an order you expect to be progressing is worth raising with FUSE.

403.description: The `v1_fulfillment` endpoint group is not enabled for your clinic

404.description: Order not found. Returned for an unknown id, a malformed (non-UUID) id, and an id belonging to another clinic — the three are deliberately indistinguishable.

delete.description:
Delete one of the clinic's programs.

Removes the program outright only when nothing is in flight. If work
remains (active orders, enrollments) the program is *retired* instead:
it stops being offered to new patients, while patients already on it
continue their treatment. A retired program is removed once all of its
in-flight work has finished; note that a patient who keeps renewing has
no natural end, so do not build automation that assumes the program will
disappear on its own.

**Returns 409 `WINDDOWN_CONSENT_REQUIRED` when the program still has
patients on it.** This endpoint carries no wind-down opt-in,
so it can only retire passively — which for an enrolled program means
the patients are never told and their subscriptions keep billing, so it
is refused rather than done silently.

**Ending a program that still has patients is not currently available
over this API.** The wind-down opt-in
(`POST /programs/{id}/retire-with-winddown`) is exposed only on the
authenticated brand-admin portal, not on this API-key surface — a
deliberate limit, because it emails patients and cancels their
subscriptions. Use the brand admin portal for that action. Over this
API, `deactivate` stops the program being offered to new patients but
does not stop billing anyone already enrolled.

409.description:
The program still has patients on it. Ending it requires the explicit
wind-down opt-in — see `POST /programs/{id}/retire-with-winddown`.

patients.description: How many patients are still on the program.

post.summary: Set a program's picture from an image URL.
post.description: Sets the picture shown for this program on the brand's storefront. Send the https address of a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image (5 MB max); FUSE downloads it, stores its own copy, and uses that, so the original address can change or disappear afterwards. The address must be a public website, must not redirect, and must serve the image file itself. The program must belong to the key's brand. For a live program, the FUSE AI connector asks the user to confirm first.

imageUrl.description: The https address of the image file.

400.description: The image was refused: IMAGE_URL_INVALID, IMAGE_URL_NOT_ALLOWED (not https, or not a public host), IMAGE_FETCH_FAILED (unreachable, redirect, non-200, timeout), IMAGE_TOO_LARGE, or NOT_AN_IMAGE.

get.summary: Effective per-product patient pricing for a program.
get.description: The price a patient is actually shown and charged for each product in this program, after the authoritative fee resolution (clinic override -> program base fee -> tenant placeholder). Mirror `displayPrice` on your own website to stay in sync with FUSE checkout — do NOT add `nonMedicalServiceFee` to it, and do NOT multiply it by a number of months (it prices one PACK — see `packDurationMonths`). `hasResolvedPrice` means a price and a pharmacy cost resolve; it is NOT an activation gate, and no /api/v1 endpoint answers "safe to publish" today (see that field's description). To CHANGE a price, PUT /api/v1/programs/{id} with `productPricing[globalProductId].programFee` and re-read this endpoint.

201.description: Runs started. Only contacts who can receive at least one of the sequence's message channels get a run: email steps need `notifyProductNews`, SMS steps need `notifySmsUpdates`, and an unsubscribed contact gets neither. Tag sends report who was skipped in `data.skipped`. A started contact who loses a channel (for example texts go, emails don't) is listed in `data.skippedChannels` (single contact) or `data.partiallySkipped` (tag).

409.description: Nothing was sent: no target contact can receive the sequence (`code: CONTACT_NOT_REACHABLE`). For a contact who hasn't opted in to marketing email, record consent with PUT /api/v1/contacts/{id}/marketing-consent.

post.summary: Create a checkout session for one of the clinic's own programs
post.description: Creates the session bookkeeping row for the FUSE-hosted, iframe-isolated intake+checkout component. Computes and stores questionnaireVersionHash (the legal audit trail — sha256 over the program's questionnaire content at creation time) and returns an opaque sessionToken + embedUrl the brand mounts in an iframe. This is the ONE endpoint a PUBLISHABLE key (`fuse_pk_…`) may call — every other endpoint on this surface, including GET /checkout/sessions/{id}, 403s a publishable key with `KEY_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED`. Publishable keys are additionally hard rate-limited on this route.

400.description: Bad request (missing/invalid programId, metadata, or successUrl) or NO_QUESTIONNAIRE_CONFIGURED

403.description: Insufficient scope (INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE) — read-only key attempted a write

get.summary: Get checkout session status (own-clinic only)
get.description: Returns session status + orderId (once completed) — NEVER intake questions or answers. Secret keys only: a publishable key gets 403 `KEY_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED` here too, even though it authenticated successfully.

403.description: Publishable key used on a route it may not call (KEY_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED)

post.summary: Register an outbound webhook endpoint
post.description: Register a publicly-reachable HTTPS endpoint to receive signed, opaque-id-only checkout lifecycle events (`session.completed`, `order.created`, `payment.succeeded`), intake conversion events (`intake.started`, `intake.abandoned`), order/fulfillment events (`order.placed`, `order.cancelled`, `order.doctor_approved`, `order.doctor_denied`, `order.sent_to_pharmacy`, `order.shipped`, `order.delivered`, `payment.failed`, `shipment.updated`), telehealth events (`appointment.scheduled`, `appointment.cancelled`) and suppression sync (`contact.unsubscribed`) instead of polling GET /checkout/sessions/{id}. The full accepted event set is the 17-value enum below — registration rejects anything else with 400. Each delivery body is `{ id, event, createdAt, data:{ …opaque ids + event-specific fields } }`; the exact per-event payload key sets are documented in docs/api/external-brand-api/OUTBOUND-WEBHOOKS.md (source of truth: BRAND_WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_KEYS in patient-api/src/services/brand-webhook-dispatch.service.ts). Note `order.doctor_denied` is accepted at registration but currently has no firing source in the API — it is declared for forward compatibility and will not be delivered until the denial chokepoint emits it. Verify `X-Fuse-Signature: t=<unixSeconds>,v1=<hex>` (HMAC-SHA256 over `<t>.<rawBody>` keyed by the endpoint secret) and dedupe on `X-Fuse-Idempotency-Key` (stable across retries and replays; `X-Fuse-Delivery-Id` is a per-attempt id, not a dedupe key). URLs that resolve to private/link-local addresses are refused and 3xx redirects are not followed (SSRF protection). The secret is returned in THIS response ONLY and is never retrievable again. Requires write scope; secret keys only.

403.description: Insufficient scope, or a publishable key used on a route it may not call

post.summary: Retired — use POST /api/v1/sandbox/go-live/link.
post.description: Retired. Going live now happens on the hosted Go live page, which collects the company's details the signer's onboarding needs. Get a private link to it with POST /api/v1/sandbox/go-live/link. This operation always answers 410 `USE_GO_LIVE_PAGE` and sends nothing.

post.summary: Get a private link to the hosted Go live page.
post.description: Returns a private link, valid for 30 minutes, that opens the hosted Go live page already signed in as the developer, and `choices` — the two ways to go live, each with its own link. `diy` opens the self-serve form: the developer enters the company's details exactly as on its formation documents, sees a pre-check of them, chooses a plan, and names the authorized signer (who can be the developer). `guided` opens the "Book a call" step for a guided Growth launch or Partner, which sends the developer to the team's calendar. Used by the FUSE AI connector when a user asks to go live. A live brand's key gets `alreadyLive: true` and no link.

choices.description: The two ways to go live. Absent when `alreadyLive` is true.

404.description: ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND — the key's organization no longer exists.

409.description: NO_DEVELOPER_ACCOUNT — the sandbox has no developer account to sign the link in as.

503.description: GO_LIVE_PAGE_UNAVAILABLE — the hosted page is not enabled in this environment.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Clinic-scoped API key. Keep server-side; never expose in a browser or app bundle.

BearerAuth.description: FUSE brand-admin JWT (from POST /auth/signin). Used ONLY by the key-management endpoints — the external /api/v1 surface never accepts JWTs, and API keys never work on key management.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, inactive, or expired API key (or JWT)

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted (insufficient scope, wrong role, or FUSE feature not enabled)

NotFound.description: Resource not found (or not owned by the key's clinic)

BadRequest.description: Bad request / business-rule failure (may include a `code`)

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded for this key. Respect the `Retry-After` header. Applies to every endpoint.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Failure shape. NOTE: most modules use `message`; programs endpoints use `error`. Read both. Some errors include a machine-readable `code` and/or a `data` payload.

Product.description: Full management view (serializeProduct) — all Product columns plus derived fields.

activeIngredients.description: Active ingredients. Accepts either a bare string per entry (the original shape, still fully supported) or an object with `name` and optional `strength`. Stored as `{name, strength}`; a null strength means "not recorded" and is never inferred from the name.

Program.description: Program.toJSON plus derived links and ClinicProgram overrides.

productPricing.description: Per-product pricing, keyed by globalProductId. Writing `programFee` sets this brand's authoritative patient price for that product (persisted on ClinicProgramGlobalProduct) and is rejected if it would put the product below margin. Read the resulting effective prices back from GET /api/v1/programs/{id}/products.

programFee.description: The all-in patient price per cycle for this product, in USD. This is the brand's own price and the only field that changes what checkout charges. Null clears the override.

monthlyDiscountPercent.description: Percentage discount applied to the monthly plan (0-100).

multiMonthPlans.description: Optional prepay plans (e.g. 3-month) offered for this product.

linkSource.description: Which link source offered this product — the storefront's fallback chain: the program's own links, its template's links, or the teleform's approved product pool.

isPatientVisible.description: Whether the brand has this product switched on for its storefront.

displayPrice.description: What the patient is charged per cycle before discounts/coupons and before the program-level nonMedicalServiceFee. Null when the product is not sellable (checkout would reject it) — never fall back to a pharmacy cost.

effectiveProgramFee.description: Configured fee after clinic-override -> program-base resolution (0 = none).

clinicProgramFee.description: This brand's own override — what PUT /programs/{id} productPricing writes.

placeholderPrice.description: Tenant SUGGESTION only. Not the canonical fee.

pharmacyBasePrice.description: The REAL pharmacy cost plus facilitation fees — the floor a fee must clear. Never a placeholder substitution, so a placeholder in front of a higher pharmacy cost cannot read as the cost.

facilitationFee.description: Clinic-level plus per-product facilitation fee included in pharmacyBasePrice.

packDurationMonths.description: How many BILLING MONTHS one unit of displayPrice covers. displayPrice is the price of ONE PACK, not of one month: checkout charges the chargeable unit price times the number of PACKS a term needs, so displayPrice times months is WRONG whenever a pack spans more than one month. A 3-month pack on a 6-month term is TWO packs, not six.

supplyDays.description: Days of supply for the pharmacy cadence — not a billing quantity.

allowPrepay.description: Whether multi-month prepay terms may be offered for this product. Never null: an unknown value would let a storefront offer a term checkout then rejects.

isSellable.description: A positive chargeable price resolves (fee half of the shared predicate).

isCostBacked.description: A pharmacy cost resolves to dispense against (cost half).

hasResolvedPrice.description: This product resolves a chargeable price AND a pharmacy cost AND is switched on for the storefront. NOT an activation-readiness signal: it does not check the program's activation status, does not check the questionnaire's FUSE clinical approval, and the pharmacy cost is priced-anywhere rather than per shipping state — a product priced in some states and unpriced in others still reads true. No endpoint on this API answers "safe to publish" today: GET /api/v1/programs/{id}/products/activation-status returns only per-product on/off toggles (ClinicProgramGlobalProduct.isActive), not a gate, and per-state pharmacy coverage is available only from GET /api/v1/public/products/{productId}/pharmacy-coverages. Treat this field as "a price and a generic pharmacy cost resolve" and nothing more.

nonMedicalServiceFee.description: The LEGACY per-program non-medical service fee, and 0 for every program with GlobalProduct links (which is every program sold today). DO NOT add it to displayPrice: for a GlobalProduct program the fee is already baked into the per-product price and is only derived afterwards for ledger bookkeeping — what Stripe recurs is the resolved per-product price with nothing added. See nonMedicalServiceFeeIncludedInDisplayPrice.

nonMedicalServiceFeeIncludedInDisplayPri.description: True when the non-medical service fee is already inside displayPrice (a GlobalProduct-linked program). When true, displayPrice is the whole per-cycle product charge.

notifyProductNews.description: The contact opted in to marketing email. Sequence emails are sent only to contacts where this is true.

notifySmsUpdates.description: The contact opted in to text messages. Sequence SMS steps are sent only when this is true.

SequenceStep.description: A delay, email, or sms step. Requires an id (or step_id) and a type (or stepType). delay steps carry timeSeconds; email/sms steps carry a templateId or custom text.

programId.description: Must belong to the key's own clinic (404 otherwise).

metadata.description: Brand-supplied data, stored verbatim and capped at 16 KiB (DB CHECK constraint plus model-layer validation). FUSE never displays or acts on it, with one exception: the marketing-attribution keys lead_id (or legacy leadId), utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, gclid and fbclid are copied onto the resulting order and echoed on the intake.started webhook. Every other key is ignored.

successUrl.description: Absolute https:// URL only — http/javascript:/data: and relative paths are rejected. Navigates the checkout IFRAME after payment, never the brand's page — move your own page from the fuse:completed event instead.

sessionToken.description: Opaque, HMAC-signed, short-lived (~30 min) credential for the embed page (not this API-key-authenticated surface) to load and render the session's questionnaire.

embedUrl.description: Mount this in an iframe on the brand's page.

orderId.description: Set once the embed flow completes checkout.
